text:
Carmen: Anyone doing something fun this weekend? I was thinking of a quick day trip to the coast, surf or beach picnic.
Leo: Sounds great. I can drive if we leave early. How about Saturday morning?
Asha: I have an art fair on Saturday afternoon, but I could join a beach picnic after. Will there be shade?
Carmen: We can bring a pop-up shade and umbrella. Plan: meet at 9:30 at office bike rack, drive/carpool to Harbor Point.
Diego: Count me in. I'll bring a frisbee and a small cooler with drinks. I might be a little late, aim for 10 if traffic.
Leo: No worries Diego. If anyone wants coffee en route I can stop by the 7-11.
Asha: I can bring a light picnic blanket and some sparkling water. Also tagging BotReminder to add to calendar.
BotReminder: Event created by Carmen: "Harbor picnic + optional surf" Saturday 10:00 - Harbor Point Parking.
Carmen: If surf looks flat we can switch to a coastal hike instead. Flex plan.
Diego: Also FYI parking fee is $5 on weekends. Bring cash or pay app.
Asha: Sounds good. Any dietary restrictions? I will bring vegetarian wraps.
Leo: I'm allergic to shellfish, please avoid fish-heavy dishes.
Carmen: Noted. We'll keep it shellfish-free. See you Saturday.
Leo: Great. I'll coordinate cars in the carpool thread.
BotReminder: Reminder set for 2 hours before event.
_meta: watercooler thread: weekend picnic and surf plans
